# VeriFix

> VeriFix is a coding agent not allowed to say "fixed" until it has proved it
> broke nothing else: it maps downstream callers before patching, checks the
> patch against the bug and the caller contracts, and rolls back when a
> contract breaks. Built by Team HyperX for neatHack 2026.

An agent starts with agent.md. It holds the preflight, the install, the
commands with `--json` output, the statuses and the safety rules.

## Read agent.md first

- [agent.md](https://shivanshjain456.github.io/neatHack/agent.md): The agent quickstart lists every step. Read it and follow it.
- [llms-full.txt](https://shivanshjain456.github.io/neatHack/llms-full.txt): agent.md plus the known limits and the receipt format in one file.
- [README](https://github.com/shivanshjain456/neatHack/blob/main/README.md): What the product does, the controlled experiment, and the evidence map.
- [Agent skill](https://github.com/shivanshjain456/neatHack/tree/main/skills/verifix): A SKILL.md folder to copy into `.claude/skills/`.

## Read the design in three docs

- [Known limits](https://shivanshjain456.github.io/neatHack/KNOWN_LIMITS.md): What VeriFix does not do, dated and honest.
- [Technical reference](https://github.com/shivanshjain456/neatHack/blob/main/docs/TECHNICAL_REFERENCE.md): Architecture, gates and the claim ledger.
- [Evaluation](https://github.com/shivanshjain456/neatHack/blob/main/docs/EVALUATION.md): Method and data behind the controlled experiment.

## Fetch the public data as JSON

- [receipts/index.json](https://github.com/shivanshjain456/neatHack/blob/main/benchmarks/receipts/index.json): One priced, sha256-hashed receipt per recorded run.
- [cost_caps.json](https://github.com/shivanshjain456/neatHack/blob/main/benchmarks/cost_caps.json): How the $0.25 public cap relates to measured run costs.
- [verified_runs_ledger.json](https://github.com/shivanshjain456/neatHack/blob/main/benchmarks/verified_runs_ledger.json): The versioned ledger behind every run stat.
- [Live API workspace](https://e6utpuirdzj7k4vu2fqlxlhvwm0cqzfv.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/api/workspace): Recorded runs, benchmarks and partner evidence, served live.

## Try it

- [Dashboard](https://shivanshjain456.github.io/neatHack/): Mission control; `#verify` maps every claim to an official judging weight, `#benchmarks` runs the agent live.
- `pip install git+https://github.com/shivanshjain456/neatHack` then `verifix --help`.
